$comment: Everything the Kohral runtime image pulls from outside this repository, pinned.
Same discipline as Kohral's own runtime/upstreams.lock.json: one entry is updated
per Kevin release, never on an unattended schedule, and `deploy/kohral/Dockerfile`
verifies the digest at build time. See deploy/kohral/README.md, 'Pins and updates'.
plan/09-security.md: worker CLIs in the container image are installed at pinned

builder.note: Build platform only; cross-compiles to the target. Not digest-pinned because the release workflow records the resulting image digest and the binary is built --locked from Cargo.lock. [inferred — verify] whether Kohral requires digest pins on build stages too.

runtime.note: Trixie, not bookworm: fastembed's prebuilt ONNX Runtime needs libstdc++ symbols bookworm's GCC 12 does not export.

memory.note: The stack's Postgres. plan/08 §6 says pg17 [inferred — verify]; Kevin's migrations and CI both run Postgres 16 + pgvector, so the stack matches CI. Kohral's provisioner pins this by digest at rollout.

node.note: Checksums copied from https://nodejs.org/dist/v24.19.0/SHASUMS256.txt (fetched 2026-08-22). Node 24 is the current LTS line ('Krypton').

agent_clis.$comment: Versions are the ones Kevin's worker adapters were written and tested against (plan/04-workers.md); `npm install --save-exact` installs exactly these. Integrity is the npm registry's dist.integrity for that exact version.

codex.note: Pulls a per-architecture optional dependency carrying the Rust binary, which is why the CLIs are installed in the target-native runtime stage.

pi.note: plan/08 §6 guessed `@mariozechner/pi-coding-agent` and marked it [inferred — verify]: that is the package's old name, last published 0.73.1. The current one is `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent`, which is what `pi --version` 0.84.2 on the reference machine reports.

embedding_model.note: `memory.embedding_model = "BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5"` resolves to this ONNX mirror inside fastembed 6.0 (`model_code`). Baked into the image so a fresh agent does not spend its first turn downloading 130 MB; the layer is reproducible because the revision is pinned and every file is checksummed.
